profile_hash_rule: sha256 over canonical JSON with profile_hash set to sha256:SELF_EXCLUDED

invariants.description: Rejects if receipt missing or lineage_hash does not equal payload_hash.
Validates receipt fields id, lineage_hash, issued_at, issuer_id, and signature exist and are well-typed strings.

Verifies receipt lineage_hash equals the canonical payload hash and issuer_id equals membrane/preflight/v1. Signature field is presence-checked only in V1 and creates no cryptographic authority claim.
If lineage_provenance or lineage_binding fails, final decision is REJECT.
